title: The invoice that wasn't
summary: A fake overdue invoice reaches three people at Kestrel Logistics. One opens it. An hour later the HR and Finance folders are encrypted. Find patient zero, trace the attack, contain it and choose a backup to restore.
ctf: The loader's campaign value hides a flag (step 7). Submit it on the CTF board as "The invoice that wasn't".

playbook.trigger: A user reports a suspicious invoice email, or the file share starts filling with renamed files
decisions: Isolate hosts now, or watch the attacker first?
Restore from backup before or after eradication?
Any contact with the attackers: only leadership, with legal advice
targets: Contain within 1 hour of the first alert
Clean restore of the HR share within 24 hours
notify: CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing it (2022 Directions)
Data Protection Board and affected people, if personal data is breached and the DPDP breach rules are in force (check the date)
The real Kestrel Logistics domain owner about the lookalike
done: hr-pc07 rebuilt and the task, admin account and loader removed
Indicators blocked at mail, proxy and firewall
Lessons-learned meeting held with owners and dates
